Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the WebSurfer agent incorrectly concluded that "Gimme Shelter" was Oscar-nominated. The analysis of the search results showed that the visible text only mentioned the film in the context of the "Maysles Collection" archive page, which lists films but does not explicitly state nomination status. The agent hallucinated a confirmation of nomination based on the presence of the film title in a list of notable works rather than finding explicit evidence of a nomination (e.g., "Nominee" label or entry in the Winners & Nominees list). This led to a false conclusion that both films were nominated, whereas the task required distinguishing which one was nominated based on verified data.
